info.title: v2.public.get_token_by_resend_code
info.description: Use the resend code to get access token and refresh token. When you lost your access token or refresh token, you can go to authorization management page to resend code by yourselves. You can only use this endpoint in live environment, we don't support in test-stable environment.

post.description: Use the resend code to get access token and refresh token. When you lost your access token or refresh token, you can go to authorization management page to resend code by yourselves. You can only use this endpoint in live environment, we don't support in test-stable environment.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: resend_code
parameters.description: the code in redirect url after you resend code in shop authorization management page. valid for one-time use, expires in 10minutes.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

values:
<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/public/get_token_by_resend_code?partner_id=partner_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'POST',
  CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => '{
    "resend_code": "resend5a4d6e6a7a745a767276586f53476849"
}',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;
